conservative.read: This plan prioritizes capital preservation by eliminating leveraged ETFs and reducing concentration. Expect a lower target return of around 1.5% per month with significantly reduced drawdown risk.

plan: Trim leveraged ETFs (SOXL, SPAL, MUU, PLTU) to minimal levels.
Trim METU to reduce AI/Software concentration.

plan: Increase leveraged ETFs (SOXL, SPAL, MUU, PLTU) to target levels.
Increase METU to concentrate in AI/Software.
Trim QQQI to 15% to reduce broad index exposure.
Buy TZA (inverse ETF) for potential hedging.

aggressive.read: This aggressive plan targets substantial growth (around 4% per month) by increasing leveraged ETF exposure and concentration. Expect significantly higher potential upside but also much larger drawdowns and amplified losses due to leverage and ETF decay. Strict stop discipline is crucial.
